opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grants

deadlines.raw: 1st day of February, April, June, August, October and December

amount.raw: Grants up to £200 for Scheme (A), up to £500 for Scheme (B), and up to £300 for Scheme (C)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Eligible for undergraduate, Master’s and PhD student members and postdoctoral scientist members of The Society within six years of their PhD viva.
opportunities.summary: Supports attendance of Genetics Society or Special Interest Group meetings, other genetics conferences, and virtual conferences.

opportunities.title: Summer Studentship

amount.raw: £425/week allowance for up to 8 weeks, up to £750 for host laboratory expenses, and a Carer’s Award if needed

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to undergraduate students in their penultimate year of study, excluding first and final years.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding for an 8-week research project during the summer holiday, including a place at the Summer School Workshop.
